readiness.hed: Fredericksburg opens the Black Friday weekend quiet — partly sunny today near 54 with only a slight chance of light rain midday, clearing into a dry, sunny stretch Saturday near 61 and Sunday near 63, before rain returns Sunday night
readiness.insight: No active alerts are in effect for the Fredericksburg area this morning. Today brings a high near 54 with only a 20% chance of light rain between noon and 2 p.m., and southwest winds gusting to 31 mph. Tonight turns partly cloudy near 41. Saturday and Sunday both clear out nicely for any holiday-weekend travel or errands, sunny near 61 Saturday and partly sunny near 63 Sunday, before a 90% chance of rain moves back in Sunday night.
actions: Today's gusts run up to 31 mph — secure any loose holiday decorations or trash cans still out before they get knocked over.
A slight midday rain chance midday today is light and brief — no travel delays expected for Black Friday errands.
Saturday and Sunday both clear out dry and sunny — good windows for outdoor cleanup, yard work or errands held over from the holiday.
Rain returns Sunday night — plan any outdoor weekend activity for daytime hours before it moves in.
